version.changelog:
- Initial release of the CoinFound RWA read-only data skill.
- Supports GET endpoints for aggregates, timeseries, pie, list, and dataset under v1/c/rwa/*.
- Designed for third-party integrations; does not handle schema probing or snapshot refresh.
- Integrates with shared endpoint catalog, schema snapshots, and fetching scripts for standardized data retrieval.
- Provides structured responses containing request, normalized data, display data, and metadata.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: coinfound-skill
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides instructions and documentation for an AI agent to retrieve read-only Real World Asset (RWA) data from the CoinFound catalog. It operates by invoking a shared Python script (fetch_rwa.py) and referencing local JSON catalogs located in a shared directory. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found; the logic and instructions in SKILL.md and the reference files are consistent with the stated purpose of data integration.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only, read-only wrapper that relies on a shared endpoint catalog and a shared fetch_rwa.py script to perform GET requests — its declared purpose aligns with what it asks for, but it depends on external shared files (not included) that you should review before use.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim read-only GET access to CoinFound RWA endpoints; SKILL.md only references reading an endpoint catalog, schema snapshots, and invoking a shared fetch_rwa.py script to perform GETs. The requested resources match the stated purpose and no unrelated credentials or binaries are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions require reading files outside the skill folder (../../shared/coinfound_rwa/data/... and ../../shared/coinfound_rwa/scripts/fetch_rwa.py) and running the external Python script. This is coherent for a read skill but means the actual network behavior and safety depend entirely on the contents of those shared files and the fetch_rwa.py implementation (which are not included here). There is no explicit guidance about sanitizing user-provided query JSON or limiting outgoing URLs in the script.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files — lowest-risk delivery model. The skill is instruction-only and will not write files or download code itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths beyond the relative shared paths. The lack of requested secrets is proportionate to a read-only GET-only skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system presence or modify other skills. It can be invoked autonomously by the agent (platform default) but that is not unusual for a skill of this type.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill itself is coherent and low-friction, but it depends on ../../shared/coinfound_rwa/scripts/fetch_rwa.py and the shared endpoint/schema files that are not included in the skill package. Before installing or enabling the skill, review those shared files (fetch_rwa.py and the endpoint_catalog/schema snapshots) to confirm they only perform GET requests to expected CoinFound endpoints, do not contain hardcoded secrets, and do not send data to unexpected external endpoints. Also verify the shared script properly validates/sanitizes query input. If you cannot review the shared resources, run the skill in a restricted environment or deny autonomous invocation until you can audit the referenced script and data.
llm.findings: [no-regex-findings] expected: Scanner had nothing to analyze because this is an instruction-only skill with no code files. The main risk surface is the external shared script and data referenced by SKILL.md, which were not provided for scanning.
